title: Smoked German Pepper Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful vegetarian skewer dish featuring smoky peppers, onions and German sausage. Perfect for a quick and easy summer dinner.

ingredients.name: Bell peppers
ingredients.amount: 1 large red bell pepper, 1 large yellow bell pepper

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: soak in water for 30 minutes before grilling

instructions: Soak the skewers in water for 30 minutes before grilling.
Thread the German sausage, bell peppers, onions, zucchini, and mushrooms onto the skewers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Cook the sausage to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as sauerkraut or a salad.
